comment: Static battle camera tracks of the spell/attack effects, located in FF8_EN.exe (2013 Steam). eng_address = track start (VA), size = the header's size field, eng_push_operand = the imm32 of the effect's `push` before its Battle_PlayCameraAnimation call. <lang>_offset / <lang>_push_offset = what to add for that language's exe. Generated by Fujin/ResearchScript/dump_effect_cameras.py.
